i.norm: Verifies that toString() formats a group of options with null opt names correctly. When an Option has no short name (opt == null), toString() falls back to using the long option prefix ("--") followed by the long opt value. The two options added here both have null short names, so the expected string uses "--null" for the first (null long-opt) and "--[]" for the second ("[]" long-opt).
Option with both short name (opt) and long name (longOpt) set to null
Option with null short name, "[]" as long name, accepting an argument, and null description
